title.en: The Works of Heaven: Killing the Green, on Paper (excerpt)

edition.en: From chapter 13 of the Tiangong kaiwu, as given on Chinese Wikisource: the chapter's opening, the section on materials, and the first four paragraphs of the section on bamboo paper. The author's own small-character notes are kept in round brackets; the illustrations are not reproduced. Five slips in the Wikisource transcription (爲 for 與 twice, 包果 for 包裹, and two stray commas in 竹麻 and 柬啓) are corrected against Project Gutenberg eBook #25273.
edition.zh: 选自《天工开物》第十三卷，据维基文库：卷首一段、“纸料”及“造竹纸”前四段。作者原有的小字注以圆括号保留；插图未收。维基文库录文五处讹误（两处“与”误作“为”，“包裹”误作“包果”，“竹麻”“柬启”中间误加逗号）据古腾堡计划电子书 #25273 改正。

basis.en: Late Ming text printed in 1637; the author died about 1666.
basis.zh: 明末文本，1637 年刊行，作者约卒于 1666 年。

note.en: From the thirteenth chapter of The Works of Heaven, on paper: Song Yingxing's opening reflection on what carries knowledge from one age to the next, his note on materials, and his step-by-step account of making bamboo paper in Fujian. The excerpt leaves out the last paragraph of that section and the section on bark paper. Notice the recycled sheets that northerners called paper of the returning soul.
note.zh: 选自《天工开物》第十三卷“杀青”，讲造纸：宋应星卷首关于知识靠什么承载、代代相传的感想，关于纸料的说明，以及福建造竹纸的逐步记述。节选未收该节最后一段和“造皮纸”一节。留意北方人称为“还魂纸”的再生纸。

excerpt.orig: 殺其青而白乃見，萬卷百家，基從此起。
excerpt.en: Kill the green, and the white appears; ten thousand scrolls and a hundred schools of thought are founded on this.
excerpt.zh: 杀其青而白乃见，万卷百家，基从此起。
